verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a working llms.txt hub and markdown-mirrored docs for the Agents SDK, confirmed live via HTTP 200 probes, letting an AI-native user or agent directly ingest agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually consuming llms.txt to complete a task, and confirmation that the SDK's own GitHub Pages docs (not just developers.openai.com) expose an llms.txt.
